metadata.name: Isaac Run History
metadata.description:
[h1]Isaac Run History[/h1]
Records every run you play - wins, deaths and restarts - with the items you picked up floor by floor, bosses, the cause of death, final stats and the seed. Export the history as one JSON file and get statistics on [url=https://tomandes.eu]tomandes.eu[/url].
[h2]How to use[/h2] Open the console and click [b]Run History[/b] in the menu bar, or use: [list] [*][b]runhistory[/b] (or [b]rh[/b]) - list your last 10 runs [*][b]rh export[/b] - copy the whole history (JSON) to the clipboard [*][b]rh path[/b] - where the history file is [/list]
[h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*][b]Repentance+[/b] required [*][url=https://repentogon.com]REPENTOGON[/url] required [*]Works together with ShareSeed (its share code is stored with each run) [/list]
